title: GuardianPolicy
description: Formal spec §5. The full set of configurable consensus thresholds governing a ward's guardians.
$comment: REQ-5-9: additionalProperties is true deliberately -- a verifier must ignore any field it doesn't recognize, so a future version can add new policy fields (a witness threshold, say) without breaking a verifier built against this one.

recovery_threshold.description: REQ-5-2: governs a guardian-initiated custodial_rotate. Default "any".

removal_threshold.description: REQ-5-4: governs both a forced guardian_remove and guardian_relinquish. Default "majority".

policy_threshold.description: REQ-5-6: governs policy_update itself, evaluated against its own currently-effective value. Default "majority".

min_guardian_count.description: REQ-5-7: enforced on guardian_remove only, never guardian_relinquish. 0 means no minimum.

on_orphan.description: REQ-5-8: the ward's own standing preference if its guardian set becomes empty other than via guardian_relinquish.
